title: Yank the trombonist compared with another trombonist
summary: Howard praises Yank's trombone playing and says he would hire him for style and feeling.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: You hear more about him, with your gang, I wonder if it was Yank.
Well, Yank was fine, trombone man. Trombone. Fine, trombone man, yeah.
Was he as good as Buddy in your clothes, or?
Well, different style? It was a different style, first I feel about it. That's the way I feel about it. To me, if they had to hire, I would rather hire Yank. You know what I mean?
It's like the style and feeling.
